tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Read the documented problem, solution and outcomes of a published technical case. Use an exact slug from search_cases. Missing evidence remains unspecified.

slug.description: Exact case slug returned by search_cases.

tools.name: get_engagement_models
tools.description: Compare research partnership, product co-building and a dedicated R&D team: the client question, DRL's role, expected deliverable and scope.

tools.name: get_lab
tools.description: Read one laboratory's published specializations, research directions and system focus. Includes the full Markdown profile and project-evidence links.

tools.name: list_labs
tools.description: List DRL's three published laboratories and their main specializations. Use get_lab with a returned ID for research directions and systems.

tools.name: prepare_inquiry
tools.description: Fill the enquiry form on the current page with the user's email and request type for review. The user can edit and press Send request. Returns prepared, not submitted.

email.description: Email address provided by the user for a reply.

request_type.description: build-product, improve-system, research, partnership, media or other.

tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Search published DRL technical case studies using short keywords and an optional laboratory. Results are stable and paginated. Featured Outrider/Moxie references are at /#work.

query.description: Short keywords, for example robotics, voice or retrieval. Empty returns recent cases.

limit.description: Number of cases per page, from 1 to 5.
